chain_words.nuance: requires effort and stimulates the person doing it
general description of something hard to do or understand
requires a great deal of time, energy or attention
extremely hard and tiring, over a long period

explanation: These words all describe something hard to do, from a mildly complicated task to an extremely exhausting one.

usage_notes.difference: 'Difficult' describes any task that is hard; 'arduous' is more formal and suggests a long, exhausting effort.
